negative_reviews.author: S X
negative_reviews.text:
The staff were friendly and the restaurant was clean, so no complaints there. However, the food was a major disappointment, especially given the prices.

Everything arrived so quickly that it felt less like a restaurant meal and more like pre-prepared food being assembled. The ramen lacked the depth, freshness, and attention to detail I would expect from a place specializing in Japanese cuisine. The broth tasted generic and lacked the richness of a properly cooked stock, while the noodles and toppings felt highly standardized and pre-portioned.

What also struck me was that I couldn't see any real kitchen operation, which only reinforced the impression that much of the food was prepared elsewhere and simply finished on-site.

The biggest surprise, however, was the rating. After eating here, I genuinely struggled to understand how this place scores so highly. Perhaps many customers are drawn to the Japanese branding, trendy atmosphere, or fast service, but based on food quality alone, I found it very ordinary.
